register.labelZh: GIVE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: give in 表示停止抵抗;give up 表示停止某項活動或嘗試;give up on somebody/something 則表示不再相信某人或某事能成功。；你可以 give of your time,表示付出時間;give something back,表示歸還物件;give somethingaway,表示送出物件;give something out,則表示派發物品。；give off 可以描述熱力、光或氣味;give onto 可以描述門窗通往哪裏;give out 則可以表示電池、聲音或供應停止運作。；give somebody away 可以表示暴露秘密,也可以用於婚禮情境;give something over 表示轉交控制權或使用權;give yourself up 則表示投降。
register.summaryEn: Give in describes stopping your resistance. Give up describes stopping an activity or attempt, while give up on somebody or something shows that you no longer expect success. You can give of your time, give an object back, give unwanted things away or give papers out to a group. Give off can describe heat, light or smells. Give onto describes where a door or window leads, while give out can show that a battery, voice or supply has stopped working. Give somebody away can reveal a secret or have a special wedding meaning. Give something over transfers its control or use, while give yourself up describes surrendering.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；使用 him、her、it 或 them 時,請按照以上例子放在正確位置。；(我讓步了。)I gave my test in.(我交上了測驗。)Her eyes gave her away.(她的眼神暴露了她。)She gave the books away.(她把書送了出去。)請閱讀整個情境,以分辨外形相近但意思不同的 GIVE 片語動詞。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. When using him, her, it or them, place the word as shown: give it back give them away give him up give it in give them out Some GIVE expressions look similar but have very different meanings: I gave in.

comparisons.zh: give off 可以描述熱力、光或氣味;give onto 可以描述門窗通往哪裏;give out 則可以表示電池、聲音或供應停止運作。
comparisons.en: Give off can describe heat, light or smells. Give onto describes where a door or window leads, while give out can show that a battery, voice or supply has stopped working.

examples.en: The candle gives off a sweet smell.
examples.zh: 蠟燭散發出香甜的氣味。

comparisons.titleZh: 談論秘密、控制權和投降
comparisons.titleEn: Talk about secrets, control and surrender
comparisons.zh: give somebody away 可以表示暴露秘密,也可以用於婚禮情境;give something over 表示轉交控制權或使用權;give yourself up 則表示投降。
comparisons.en: Give somebody away can reveal a secret or have a special wedding meaning. Give something over transfers its control or use, while give yourself up describes surrendering.

examples.en: The doors give onto a small garden.
examples.zh: 這些門通往一個小花園。
